I can only give you one night of your sleep for last week, and that's not enough for a weekly summary.

**What's in your local data (Mon Oct 26 to Sun Nov 1, New York time):**
- **Sun Nov 1:** 420 minutes asleep (7 hours 0 minutes). The session ran from 11:00 PM on Oct 31 to 7:00 AM on Nov 1.
- **Mon Oct 26 through Sat Oct 31:** no sleep records.

I can't tell whether those nights are missing from the data or were never recorded. Google isn't connected on this machine, so nothing has been synced from your account. Missing days shouldn't be read as zero hours of sleep.

**How overnight dates work:** a sleep session is filed under the calendar date you wake up. Last night's sleep (Oct 31 at 11 PM to Nov 1 at 7 AM) counts as Sunday, Nov 1. So a Monday-to-Sunday week includes the sleep you got on Sunday night's wake-up, but not the sleep that ended on Monday morning.

**To get the full week:** connect your Google account so I can import the history. Connecting opens a browser sign-in, so I'll only do it if you say so. Once it's connected, I can import the sleep data and calculate the weekly average. I can also run the Monday-to-Sunday summary again after the import finishes.
